  "question_leak_note": "The question asks for the most likely root cause and supporting spec clauses but does not name or strongly imply a specific fault category.",
  "evidence_supports_conclusion": "partial",
  "evidence_note": "The KPI changes (UL SNR and RSRP drop, UL traffic drop, slight PRB utilization increase) indicate uplink quality degradation, but they do not uniquely identify co‑channel interference versus a simple received‑power loss.",
  "unsupported_claims_in_conclusion": [
    "The definitive labeling of the root cause as \"Co‑Channel Interference (Severe)\" is not fully supported by the KPI evidence alone."
  ],
  "citations": [
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "A.78 Monitoring of SS-SINR",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Provides a generic definition of SINR (ratio of received signal to interference+noise) but refers to downlink SS‑SINR, not the uplink SNR metric in the data."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 32.425",
      "section": "A.9 Monitoring of RF performance",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Describes a causal chain where uplink interference degrades the base‑station receiver and overall service, but it is an LTE‑focused, informative annex and does not provide NR‑specific or severity‑specific details."
    }
  ],
  "has_adequate_mechanism_citation": false,
  "acceptable_conclusions_reasonable": true,
  "uncertainty_honest_and_complete": true,
  "uncertainty_missing": [],
  "verdict": "valid_with_changes",
  "required_changes": [
    "Temper the root‑cause label to reflect that the evidence only indicates uplink quality degradation, not definitively severe co‑channel interference.",
    "State explicitly that the KPI pattern is also consistent with a received‑power loss (e.g., antenna or RF path issue).",
    "Acknowledge the lack of an NR‑specific mechanism clause linking interference to the observed UL SNR drop."
  ],
  "confidence": 0.78
}
